items.title: Replit 不再用 Anthropic：写代码的 AI 平台先碰上了“断供”问题
items.brief: 开发者常用的 Replit 与 Anthropic 终止合作，企业把工作流绑在单一模型上会更不踏实。
items.take: Replit CEO 表示，公司已不再与 Anthropic 合作。两家公司没有在候选报道中说明分手的具体条款，但这件事点出了 AI 编程工具的现实风险：你今天习惯的模型、价格和功能，明天可能因供应商关系变化而被替换。对普通开发者，麻烦不只是换一个聊天机器人，而是提示词、代码审查和团队流程都得重新适应。

en.title: Replit drops Anthropic, exposing a supply risk in AI coding tools
en.brief: Replit and Anthropic have ended their relationship, a reminder that teams built around one model can be forced to change quickly.
en.take: Replit’s CEO says the company is no longer working with Anthropic. The available reporting does not spell out why, but the split highlights a practical weakness of AI coding tools: the model, pricing, and features a team builds around can change when a vendor relationship changes. For developers, this is more than switching chatbots; prompts, code-review habits, and team workflows may all need to be rebuilt.

items.title: Anthropic 让外部研究者看“员工级”资料，AI 安全审计往里走了一步
items.brief: 模型公司愿意给外部团队更深权限，至少不再只让人看它自己挑出来的测试结果。
items.take: Anthropic 将让模型评估机构 METR 的研究人员获得接近员工级别的内部访问权限，用来研究其系统的能力和风险。这并不等于模型已经安全，而是把评估从“公司自测后公布结论”往独立核查推了一步。真正难的部分在后面：研究者能否公开不舒服的发现，以及其他头部 AI 公司会不会接受同样的检查。

en.title: Anthropic opens deeper access to outside AI safety researchers
en.brief: Giving an outside team employee-level access is a move away from asking the public to trust only the company’s own tests.
en.take: Anthropic is allowing researchers at METR, an AI evaluation group, access at an employee-like level to study its systems’ capabilities and risks. That does not make a model safe by itself. It does move evaluation one step beyond a company testing itself and choosing what to publish. The harder questions come next: whether researchers can report uncomfortable findings, and whether other leading labs will accept comparable scrutiny.

items.title: Meta 把开源权重模型带到 Mac：本地跑 AI 更方便，责任也更难外包
items.brief: 新模型可在 Mac 上运行，敏感内容不必全传云端，但滥用和维护也更多落到用户手里。
items.take: Meta 推出一款可在 Mac 上运行的开放权重模型。所谓开放权重，简单说就是开发者能下载模型参数，在自己的设备或服务器上部署，而不是只能调用云端接口。它对隐私敏感的小团队和想控制成本的开发者很有吸引力；但模型离开平台的护栏后，内容过滤、更新和防滥用也更难由一家公司统一处理。

en.title: Meta brings an open-weight model to Macs, making local AI easier—and responsibility harder to outsource
en.brief: The model can run on Macs, keeping some sensitive work off the cloud, but leaving more safety and upkeep with the user.
en.take: Meta has released an open-weight AI model that can run on Macs. Open weights means developers can download the model parameters and deploy them on their own devices or servers rather than only calling a cloud API. That can appeal to privacy-sensitive teams and developers watching costs. But once a model leaves a platform’s guardrails, content controls, updates, and misuse prevention are also harder for one company to manage centrally.

items.title: 市场开始担心 AI 账单：科技股下跌不只是在嫌“贵”
items.brief: 美国通胀担忧叠加 AI 基建借债，投资者开始追问：数据中心的巨额投入多久能赚回来。
items.take: 科技股抛售加深，报道将其与美国通胀担忧以及 AI 基础设施融资压力联系在一起。市场并非突然不相信 AI，而是在重新计算数据中心、芯片和电力的投入能否带来足够快的收入。若融资成本持续偏高，最先被压缩的可能是烧钱扩张的项目，最终也会传到云服务价格、招聘和养老金持有的科技股表现上。

en.title: Markets are starting to question the AI bill, not just AI hype
en.brief: Inflation fears and debt for AI infrastructure are making investors ask when massive data-center spending will actually pay back.
en.take: A deeper technology sell-off has been linked in reporting to US inflation worries and the financing burden behind AI infrastructure. Investors have not suddenly stopped believing in AI; they are recalculating whether spending on data centers, chips, and power can produce revenue quickly enough. If borrowing stays expensive, cash-burning expansion plans may be cut first—eventually affecting cloud costs, hiring, and the tech shares held in retirement funds.

items.title: 霍尔木兹附近船只遇袭报告创新高，石油出口开始变慢
items.brief: 油还没断，但船东若持续绕路或停航，运费、保险和油价都会先紧起来。
items.take: BBC 报道称，霍尔木兹海峡附近的船只遇袭报告达到纪录水平，石油出口已经放缓。这里是全球最关键的能源水道之一，风险一升高，油轮就会面临更高的保险费、更慢的通行和改道选择。普通人未必立刻在加油站看到价格变化，但运输成本会先沿着油价、航运和化工品往外传。

en.title: Record ship-attack reports near Hormuz are already slowing oil exports
en.brief: Oil has not stopped flowing, but if tankers keep detouring or waiting, freight, insurance, and fuel prices will tighten first.
en.take: The BBC reports that ship-attack reports near the Strait of Hormuz have hit a record high and oil exports have slowed. This is one of the world’s most important energy waterways. Higher risk means higher insurance costs, slower crossings, and more detours for tankers. Drivers may not see an immediate change at the pump, but the added transport cost can move through oil, shipping, and chemical products.

en.title: Ukraine says military Starlink is still not fully restored—a commercial network is affecting the front line
en.brief: Ukraine says military access is still incomplete, showing that getting online in a war is no longer just a technical issue.
en.take: Zelenskyy says Starlink access for Ukraine’s military has not been fully restored, while Trump denies restricting Ukraine’s use of the network. Both claims remain in the picture. What is clear is that satellite connectivity is deeply woven into frontline communications, drone coordination, and unit contact. The rules or coverage of one commercial service can affect military capability, sharpening allies’ concerns about relying on a single private platform for critical infrastructure.

items.title: 英国给中国电动车关税留了后门，买车选择可能更少也更贵
items.brief: 若英国加入欧盟本地化计划，政府可能对中国电动车加税，价格战未必还能这么打。

items.title: 巴西通过缩短工时：多一天时间，还是更高的用工成本？
items.brief: 巴西国会批准更短工作周，员工可能多些休息，但企业如何补人和付钱才是下一道题。
items.take: 巴西国会批准缩短工作周，这是卢拉政府的一项重要劳动政策胜利。报道未在候选材料中给出最终工时细节，但改革的拉扯很直白：员工希望少一些长工时，雇主则要面对排班、加班费和可能新增的人手。它能否真正改善生活，不只看法案通过，更看执行规则是否让低收入劳动者少丢收入。

en.title: Brazil approves a shorter workweek: more time off, or higher labor costs?
en.brief: Brazil’s Congress has approved a shorter workweek; workers may gain time, but employers still have to solve staffing and pay.
en.take: Brazil’s Congress has approved a shorter workweek, a major labor-policy win for Lula’s government. The available candidate report does not state the final hours in detail, but the trade-off is plain: workers want fewer long hours, while employers face scheduling, overtime, and possibly more hiring. Whether it improves daily life will depend not only on passage, but on whether implementation protects lower-income workers from losing pay.

items.title: 巴基斯坦学校屋顶坍塌致至少34人死亡，校舍安全不能只等事故后追责
items.brief: 遇难者包括33名学生和一名教师，学校建筑的日常检查比事后道歉更要紧。
items.take: BBC 报道，巴基斯坦一所学校屋顶坍塌，至少造成33名学生和一名教师死亡。这类灾难最刺眼的地方是，孩子每天必须进入的建筑，本应是最不能靠运气的地方。事故原因、建筑维护记录和是否存在预警仍待调查；但对家长和教育部门而言，校舍检查、承载改造和责任追溯都不应等到下一次坍塌才开始。

en.title: At least 34 die in Pakistan school roof collapse—school safety cannot wait for the next disaster
en.brief: The dead include 33 pupils and a teacher; routine checks of school buildings matter more than apologies afterward.
en.take: The BBC reports that a school roof collapse in Pakistan killed at least 33 pupils and one teacher. The cruel fact is that a building children must enter every day should never depend on luck. The cause, maintenance record, and any missed warnings still need investigation. But for parents and education authorities, building inspections, structural repairs, and accountability should not begin only after another collapse.

The collapse happened at a school in Pakistan
The reason for the roof collapse remains under investigation
impacts: Families

items.title: 俄勒冈小学枪击致4人死亡，学校的“最后一道防线”又被击穿
items.brief: 一名青少年在小学杀害4人，事后再完善预案，仍替代不了提前识别风险和限制枪支接触。
items.take: 美国俄勒冈州发生小学枪击案，报道指一名青少年杀害4人。事件的具体经过和嫌疑人背景仍会由调查厘清，但校园暴力的难题从来不只在事发当刻：学校怎样接住明显求助或危险信号、家庭如何安全保管枪支、警方和心理服务能否及时衔接，往往决定悲剧有没有机会被提前挡住。

en.title: Four killed in an Oregon elementary-school shooting, again breaching the last line of school safety
en.brief: A teenager killed four people at an elementary school; post-attack plans cannot replace early risk detection and safe gun storage.
en.take: An elementary-school shooting in Oregon killed four people, with reporting identifying the suspect as a teenager. Investigators still need to establish the sequence of events and motive. But the central problem in school violence is not only the moment of attack: whether schools catch warning signs, families secure firearms, and police and mental-health services connect in time can determine whether a tragedy has a chance to be stopped earlier.
facts: Reports say four people were killed at an Oregon elementary school
Police are still investigating the events and motive
impacts: Children and parents
Fear over school safety directly changes daily family routines
Policy
Gun storage, risk intervention, and school security will again be contested
next: Police findings on events and motive
Safety measures from the school and local government
